about.title: About me
about.p1: I go by Comma — Comma-off on GitHub. I'm 11 years old, and I keep my real name private, but all my code is public.
about.p2: I like building operating system experiments, browser extensions, developer tools, and silly little projects, mostly just to see if I can.
